title: REI Clean Overlay
description: Hides selected REI overlay buttons and hint popups.
body:
It hides selected REI interface elements, such as overlay buttons and hint popups, so the inventory screen looks cleaner and more polished. The hidden elements are not removed permanently: they can be temporarily restored at any time with a configurable keybind in the game’s Controls settings.

By default, the interface buttons are hidden and no key is assigned. If you want to bring the hidden buttons back temporarily, open the Controls menu and assign a keybind for REI Clean Overlay.

This is especially useful for modpacks where REI is already configured by the pack author and players do not need quick access to every REI overlay button during normal gameplay.

**Notes**

By default, the selected REI interface buttons are hidden and the restore keybind is not assigned.
![Setting Up the Mod Activation Keybind](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8edecdb265a34e4223f9f85a10db59d5a8b0c7b.png)
This mod does not change recipes, item entries, or REI functionality itself. It only adjusts selected interface elements in the REI overlay.

**Requirements**

[Roughly Enough Items (REI)](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei)

[Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/)
